name: Clinexia_v2.0
description: Clinexia is a complete clinical toolkit and progressive web app: medical calculators, drug dosing (mg per dose and mL per dose), unit conversions, laboratory tools and reference ranges. This version (v2.0) features a modern frontend built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, designed for a smooth, responsive user experience.

paragraphs: Clinexia is a complete clinical toolkit and progressive web app: medical calculators, drug dosing (mg per dose and mL per dose), unit conversions, laboratory tools and reference ranges. This version (v2.0) features a modern frontend built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, designed for a smooth, responsive user experience.

Only: event type, tool id/name, platform (web | pwa | android | windows), app version, an anonymous random visitor id and a timestamp. Never patient data, calculator inputs or results, IP addresses or anything personally identifying. Search Console and GitHub data are aggregate counts from those services.

Privacy page. Before shipping, add one sentence to app/privacy/page.tsx where anonymous statistics are described, for example: "We also record, per day, whether an installation was active (and roughly how many sessions), and when the app was installed, using the same anonymous random ID. We do not use this to identify anyone." The tool-usage events and anonymous ID are already described there.
features: Clinical calculators, drug dosing with mg and mL per dose, and unit conversion for clinical and laboratory metrics
Real-time input validation and conversion feedback
Modular component architecture (conversion cards, input fields, selection controls)
